name: npv_zero_at_irr
derivation: cf = [-1,000,000, 0, +1,440,000] agorot. Two-cashflow IRR over 2 periods:
= -1,000,000 + 1,000,000 = 0 agorot exactly — pins the NPV(IRR) = 0 invariant on a
golden case, not just in property tests.
Simple payback: cumulative -1,000,000, -1,000,000, +440,000; recovery inside period 2:
cumulative reaches exactly 0 at t=2: 1 + 1,000,000/1,000,000 = 2 periods exact.
